narrative_arc: Stillness to explosion to triumph to brand: a young female sprinter is introduced in a serene golden-hour profile with documentary credits, holds a contemplative breath, then sets into the blocks; she explodes out and runs at full speed under flaring sun with a race timer ticking past one second; a rapid desaturated montage with kinetic Chinese type ('you think this is just one second?', 'youthful power') compresses the effort, the climax tagline '从这一秒开始' (from this very second, begin) lands on her arms-up victory, a calm hero shot delivers the quick-dry product claim, and the film closes on the ANTA arc mark on black.
creative_device: athlete-hero profile with a literal race-timer device ('one second') that the rhetorical kinetic copy reframes as a turning point, resolved by the quick-dry product claim
